A few things to know.

Can I order 9120 now?

9120 is in development. This website introduces the concept and proposed uses. A purchase package, confirmed price and order process have not yet been released.

What will I be able to customise?

We are exploring choices in layout, openings, finishes and the relationship to outdoor space. The final range and any limits will be published once the designs are coordinated.

Will it arrive as a kit or a completed building?

The supply model is being established. The final offer will explain exactly what is provided, what you need to arrange and who handles each stage.

Is Living intended as a permanent home?

Its occupancy scope is still being defined. It should not currently be understood as an approved permanent dwelling or a claim of suitability for a particular site.

Where does the configurator fit?

Open the configurator ↗. It is a separate development tool for exploring the system. The presets here explain the intended uses first. Current configurations do not constitute confirmed offers or construction-ready designs.
